concepts.title: 方案 A｜个人名片
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: polished high-fidelity native mobile UI prototype, ONE full-bleed portrait iPhone screen, approximately 1024 x 2176 proportions.
Primary request: design a new "我的" profile/account screen for 称小二, a gentle weight-management companion. The user is choosing among three different layouts before any implementation. This is a new screen generation, not a color-only edit.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved HOME screen, used ONLY as the visual-language and brand reference. Image 2 is the approved PROGRESS screen, used ONLY for matching the same app family. Neither is an edit target. Generate PROFILE screen content and its distinct layout.
Brand / style: exact name "称小二" (first character 称), apricot rounded-square icon with friendly ivory bathroom scale and cocoa details. Warm near-white #FBF9F6 canvas, navy #14204C typography, indigo #4B588E and #303E79, apricot #FBC098, peach #FFE5D5, lavender #EEEFFC, powder blue #E0EFF8, pale gold #FFF0C2, orange #CE4E09, muted slate #73798B. White soft rounded cards with extremely subtle shadows; coherent clean line icons; accurate simplified Chinese, natural native UI font, tidy touch-friendly rows. Generous useful spacing, no huge multi-line slogan taking half the page, no old forest green, no glossy/glass/neon styling.
Fixed shell: iOS status bar "18:50", Wi-Fi and battery, then brand header with scale icon and "称小二" left and quiet peach "已同步" pill right. Bottom fixed white tab bar: "今天" sun outline, "教练" chat outline, "趋势" line-chart outline, "我的" person outline. ONLY 我的 is active, navy label and indigo rounded-square backplate behind an APRICOT person-outline icon. All other tabs muted slate. Respect top and bottom safe area, show black home indicator. NO physical phone frame, external labels, comparison collage, watermark, developer/debug gear or device backdrop.
Available product features ONLY: editable nickname; health profile and editable weight-management goal; reviewing the coach's saved goals/habits/constraints and telling coach about changes; three daily notification reminders with times and switches plus save action; connecting existing WeChat customer-service identity via binding code; account/health-boundary information, logout and permanent account deletion. Account deletion must be secondary inside account management, not a large prominent destructive action on the landing screen. Main page may reorganize these existing features into detail entries. Do not invent coach shopping/style selection, subscriptions, membership, points, medals, rankings, export, settings that do not exist, or a clinical health score.
Shared DEMONSTRATION data across options (not actual user account data): nickname "小林"; initial-letter avatar "林", no avatar-upload affordance; "手机号已验证"; health profile height 170 cm, age 30–39, current weight 79.0 kg, target weight 73 kg, target date 12月28日. Coach-memory preview can mention generic saved goals/habits/constraints, not fabricated medical facts. Reminder example: "称重提醒" 08:00 enabled, "饮食记录" disabled, "晚间复盘" 21:30 enabled. WeChat state "未连接". Never invent progress percentages or imply weight-loss results from these profile values.
Composition: show one coherent usable initial profile page above bottom nav. Exact provided copy, crisp legible Chinese labels, no lorem ipsum and no dense explanatory paragraphs.
Design direction A — personal identity card + prominent health-profile summary + clean grouped navigation. Balanced personal hub, closest to the approved Home and Progress hierarchy.
Layout:
1. Under the brand header, compact navy page heading "我的".
2. A horizontal WHITE identity card: peach rounded-square avatar with the character "林", bold "小林", small muted "手机号已验证". A lavender circular pencil icon on the right edits the nickname only.
3. A wide INDIGO rounded health-profile card with the exact heading "健康档案", a small pencil icon on the right. Subtle tonal arcs match the Progress indigo card. Two clear white numerical columns labeled "当前体重" with "79.0 kg" and "目标体重" with "73 kg"; slim vertical divider. Footer a subtle line then "170 cm · 30–39 岁" on the left and "目标日期 12月28日" on the right. This is a profile/goal summary, NOT a progress chart or completion score.
4. Small heading "为你定制". A single WHITE grouped card with two roomy icon rows: "教练记住的你" with subtitle "目标、习惯与限制", right chevron; "日常提醒" with subtitle "称重、饮食与晚间复盘", right value "2 项开启" and chevron. Lavender memory icon and pale-gold bell icon.
5. Small heading "连接与账号". Another WHITE grouped card, two rows: "连接微信" with small "未连接" at right and chevron; "账号与说明" with subtitle "资料安全、健康边界与账号管理", chevron. Powder-blue chat icon and peach shield icon.
6. A quiet small centered footer "按自己的节奏，慢慢来。" if space permits, not a giant slogan.
All essentials fit one initial viewport. Do not add form fields, notification switches or a huge primary button to this variant. Main page navigates into focused editing/detail views. Profile name card, indigo health card and grouped rows must be visually distinct and beautifully spaced.

Design direction B — warm identity banner + daily reminder controls as the focal area. A visibly different layout from a metrics-led profile card, emphasizing a gentle everyday companion and practical preference management.
Layout:
1. Below brand header, a compact wide PEACH identity banner, rounded corners with barely visible warm arc at one edge. Letter avatar "林" in ivory circle, nickname "小林", muted warm-brown "手机号已验证"; small pencil edit icon at right. No giant indigo metric block in this variant.
2. Two equally sized WHITE feature tiles side by side, with different icon patches and chevrons: left lavender medical-folder outline titled "健康档案", subtitle "目标 73 kg"; right powder-blue memory outline titled "教练记住的你", subtitle "习惯与偏好". Friendly useful spacing, not tiny icon-only shortcuts.
3. Dominant WHITE rounded card heading "日常提醒", subtitle "按你的节奏安排". Three large practical rows with thin separators:
   pale-gold scale icon, "称重提醒", "08:00", indigo native switch ON;
   lavender cutlery icon, "饮食记录", muted "未开启", gray native switch OFF;
   peach moon icon, "晚间复盘", "21:30", indigo native switch ON.
   Times are clear compact tap targets. A full-width soft lavender button "保存提醒" inside the bottom of the card; staged edits require saving, do not imply automatic persistence. Friendly calm styling without green switches.
4. A small WHITE grouped card with two rows and colored icons: "连接微信" at right "未连接" and chevron; "账号与说明" with chevron and small subtitle "资料安全与健康边界".
5. Optional tiny centered "提醒可以随时调整。" in muted slate above navigation; no large moralizing slogan or motivational score.
Reference shell and active 我的 bottom tab preserved. Main visual anchor is the reminder preferences card, NOT another indigo numbers dashboard. All key UI fits an initial screen without cramming.

Design direction C — compact native grouped-settings layout with minimal card ornament. Truly distinct from the other two: no large health-value hero card and no expanded reminder control panel. Scannable categorized rows with useful right-side summaries, emphasizing ownership and ease of editing.
Layout:
1. Under brand header, concise navy heading "我的".
2. An UNBOXED personal header directly on warm canvas: medium lavender circular initial avatar "林", bold nickname "小林", small slate "手机号已验证", pencil-in-circle icon at right. A short line below "你的资料，由你说了算。" in muted slate, no giant headline.
3. Small muted group heading "个人与健康". A WHITE rounded grouped-list card with three large rows, subtle separators and coherent pastel icon patches:
   peach person outline, "称呼", right summary "小林" + chevron;
   lavender medical-folder outline, "健康档案", right summary "已填写" + chevron;
   pale-gold flag outline, "减重目标", right summary "73 kg" + chevron.
   The goal entry opens the existing health-profile goal editor, no fake extra feature.

   powder-blue chat outline, "连接微信", right summary "未连接" + chevron;
   lavender shield outline, "账号与说明", right summary "安全与健康边界" + chevron.
   Logout and permanent deletion live inside account management, not bright destructive buttons here.

First screen should feel calm and efficiently organized, not a dense spreadsheet or a lengthy settings form. Keep the palette colorful through small pastel patches rather than full solid card backgrounds. Preserve exact brand and navigation shell.
